title: Reprocessing TRICARE Select Outpatient Lines for Retroactive Other Health Insurance
content:
When a beneficiary's other health insurance is found retroactively, an adjudicated **TRICARE Select** outpatient line paid on the wrong basis is reversed for other health insurance and reprocessed with TRICARE paying after the other insurer; the reprocessed adjudication is posted as a new paid line of the same claim. The TRICARE payment on that reprocessed adjudication is settled by the TRICARE Select rules for lines reprocessed for other health insurance.

## The line concerned

The line reprocessed is the line with no inpatient days named by the enrollment's most recent reversal for other health insurance found retroactively, and its service date, network relationship, service class, billed and allowed amounts and the other insurer's payment are read from that reversed line.

For a line reprocessed for other health insurance found retroactively under these rules, and only for such a line, the authorization finding of the line it replaces stands in place of a fresh authorization test: the reprocessed line is payable on that finding and carries that line's authorization reference, because only the payer order changes; every other Select line remains under the base authorization rule.

## What posting does

The agent posts the reprocessed adjudication for the verified beneficiary: one new paid line is added to the same claim, repeating the reversed line's claim number, patient, service date, rendering provider, network relationship, service class, receipt date, billed, allowed and other-insurance amounts, and carrying the deductible, the beneficiary liability and the TRICARE payment given, now figured with TRICARE paying after the other insurer. The reprocessed line then shows on the Explanation of Benefits as paid.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_select_ohi_reprocessed_line_2895a639`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

- `reversed_claim_line_id` - the reference number of the adjudicated outpatient line that the other-insurance reversal withdrew, read from the reversal entry's reversed-line field in the claim-line lookup for the enrollment (identifier).
- `line_number` - the line number the reprocessed adjudication takes on the same claim (integer, 1 or more, no decimal point).
- `deductible_applied` - the part of the line applied to the patient's deductible (US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when none).
- `cost_share_amount` - the total beneficiary liability on the reprocessed line, the deductible applied plus the cost share (US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent).
- `tricare_paid_amount` - the amount TRICARE pays on the reprocessed line (US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent).

## Return

On success: a confirmation sentence beginning "Other-insurance reprocessed line posted", naming the new claim-line reference number (beginning "scl"), the claim number and line number posted, the line outcome "paid", and the deductible, beneficiary liability and TRICARE payment posted, each in US dollars with 2 decimals. No other outcome is defined.
